confidence_notes: Food and drink anchors come from search-result summaries of Numbeo's Split page and several 2026 Split price guides. These sources conflict and may be dated; Numbeo's copy may be older than its label. Beer uses a 0.5 L draft basis and meal anchors are food only. Cocktail and wine rest on bar price ranges cross-checked against beer (cocktail about 2.5x beer, wine about 1.2x). EUR figures were converted at an assumed 1.16 USD per EUR, not a verified current rate. Accommodation anchors are general-knowledge peak-July estimates, not checked against live listings or booking pages, and are the least certain. The FX observation is the 20 March 2026 RBA reading reported in a search summary; no later observation could be confirmed.
comparable_city_reasoning: Split-specific: food and drink use Split price evidence rather than a proxy city; Zagreb is cheaper on Numbeo and was not used. Accommodation has no comparable-city benchmark and reflects general knowledge of peak-summer Split stays.
